checkpointBoundary: Completed original 02e local frontend-quality command; product nine-layer admission and independent Controller review remain separate.
scope: All physical layer files plus actual ZIP/GZIP/TAR nested members; raw UTF-8 bytes and decoded XML/HTML/JSON strings. Image bytes are scanned without OCR or pixel inspection.
limitations: A bounded pattern scan is not a universal no-PII proof. Every shape hit needs exact classification; JWT/test-token bytes remain private. Each layer retains its own original execution identity and success/failure boundary. Image pixels were not OCR-reviewed; binary strings and actual archive members are scanned. No claim that zero shape hits proves absence of all secrets or PII.
